segments.speaker: the Lord
segments.text: Where is the bill of your mother’s divorcement, whom I have put away? or which of my creditors is it to whom I have sold you? Behold, for your iniquities have ye sold yourselves, and for your transgressions is your mother put away.

segments.speaker: The LORD
segments.text: Wherefore, when I came, was there no man? when I called, was there none to answer? Is my hand shortened at all, that it cannot redeem? or have I no power to deliver? behold, at my rebuke I dry up the sea, I make the rivers a wilderness: their fish stinketh, because there is no water, and dieth for thirst.

segments.speaker: The LORD
segments.text: I clothe the heavens with blackness, and I make sackcloth their covering.

segments.speaker: Isaiah
segments.text: The Lord GOD hath given me the tongue of the learned, that I should know how to speak a word in season to him that is weary: he wakeneth morning by morning, he wakeneth mine ear to hear as the learned.

segments.speaker: Isaiah
segments.text: ¶ The Lord GOD hath opened mine ear, and I was not rebellious, neither turned away back.

segments.speaker: Isaiah
segments.text: I gave my back to the smiters, and my cheeks to them that plucked off the hair: I hid not my face from shame and spitting.

segments.speaker: Isaiah
segments.text: ¶ For the Lord GOD will help me; therefore shall I not be confounded: therefore have I set my face like a flint, and I know that I shall not be ashamed.

segments.speaker: Isaiah
segments.text: He is near that justifieth me; who will contend with me? let us stand together: who is mine adversary? let him come near to me.

footnotes.text: + mine…: Heb. the master of my cause?

segments.speaker: Isaiah
segments.text: Behold, the Lord GOD will help me; who is he that shall condemn me? lo, they all shall wax old as a garment; the moth shall eat them up.

segments.speaker: Isaiah
segments.text: ¶ Who is among you that feareth the LORD, that obeyeth the voice of his servant, that walketh in darkness, and hath no light? let him trust in the name of the LORD, and stay upon his God.

segments.speaker: Isaiah
segments.text: Behold, all ye that kindle a fire, that compass yourselves about with sparks: walk in the light of your fire, and in the sparks that ye have kindled. This shall ye have of mine hand; ye shall lie down in sorrow.
